verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a SaaS product, so a published API spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of the candidate OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and the llms.txt and markdown docs that do exist are documentation, not API specs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
